lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Umm...

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Commander {AccountData.NickName}?

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: I'm pretty sure I said you can visit

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: me if you ever had the time, right?

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: How come you haven't stopped by?

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Have you been too busy? T^T
Been on loads of assignments lately.
I've had personal matters to attend to.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Oh, okay!

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: I figured as much.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Well, since it has been a while...

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: think you can pop in for a visit

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: if you happen to be in the area?

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: I've pretty much adjusted to leading a life in a bunker,

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: but I have started to get a little bored, hehe.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: It'd be even better if your Nikke friends can join you too.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: They're great friends to have!
We'll come visit you, promise.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Thanks!

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: I'll make sure the place is nice and presentable for you! ^___^
